items.prompt: Equal employment opportunities must _____ to all candidates regardless of gender.
items.explanation: Câu bị động với modal verb 'must be offered'.

items.prompt: The scientist _____ designed this innovative solar device won an award.
items.explanation: 'The scientist' chỉ người làm chủ ngữ -> dùng 'who'.

items.prompt: If people stop cutting down tropical forests, biodiversity _____ preserved.
items.explanation: Câu điều kiện loại 1: 'If + Present Simple, will + V'.

items.prompt: If I were the director of the national park, I _____ ecotourism strictly.
She told us that she _____ on a presentation about international organisations.
items.explanation: Câu tường thuật lùi thì về Quá khứ tiếp diễn 'was working'.

items.prompt: Electric vehicles are considered _____ for city air than traditional petrol cars.
Son Doong is the _____ cave passage discovered in the world.
items.explanation: So sánh nhất tính từ ngắn 'the largest'.

items.prompt: The documentary on marine conservation was so _____ that nobody left early.
items.explanation: Tính từ miêu tả đặc điểm của sự vật dùng đuôi '-ing' (interesting).

items.prompt: Viet Nam actively participates _____ peacekeeping missions organized by the UN.
Modern educational institutions rely heavily _____ digital learning platforms.
